## Why visit

A convenient and characterful place to explore Joseph Holt’s beer in the centre. Small drinking areas and raised pew-like seating give the pub an individual feel, while the brewery ownership supplies a clear regional-beer purpose. It is particularly useful on an arrival or departure route through Victoria and Shudehill, or as a complement to Hare & Hounds nearby. This is a stronger choice for the local tied-house experience than for chasing rare guest releases; choose accordingly and allow time to appreciate the room.

## Beer

CAMRA lists a range of Joseph Holt cask, including Bitter, IPA and Two Hoots, with availability changing.
